row.title: ROOTCAUSE-1: every finding is classified to a root cause; recurrence escalates to the root
row.body: doctrine/rootcauses.json holds root-cause classes with a guard probe; foundation/rootcause.py records occurrences, escalates a class seen on two days (or occurring with no guard) to Q-ROOT-<class>, and closes it only when the guard passes and the class stays quiet two days. Runs in the daily failure_audit pass. Staged workflow change (land ops/rootcause) is in protected/failure-audit.yml. Fixed foundation-tests: duplicate test_outreach basename renamed.
